title: 29 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Shastriji Maharaj receives diksha
story: Acharya Viharilalji Maharaj initiates Dungar Bhagat into the sadhu order and names him ’Yagnapurushdasji’. After renouncing his home in Mahelav in December 1881, young Dungar Bhagat remained in the association of his guru, Sadguru Vignananand Swami, as a parshad.
story_short: On this day in 1882, in Vartal, Dungar Bhagat was initiated as a sadhu and named Yagnapurushdasji. He became Shastriji Maharaj.
whatsapp: On this day in 1882, in Vartal, Dungar Bhagat was initiated as a sadhu and named Yagnapurushdasji. He became Shastriji Maharaj.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 94th Janma Jayanti Celebrations, Sarangpur, India
options.story:
Param Pujya Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s 94th birth celebrations, as per the Hindu Vikram calendar, were held in Sarangpur on 29th November, 2014. Many tens of thousands of devotees flocked from across the world, including USA, Canada, Europe, Africa, Middle East, Australia and New Zealand, to commemorate their beloved Guru on this special occasion.

The auspicious day began with Swamishri’s puja darshan. All the gathered devotees enjoyed the unique darshan as Swamishri performed his morning puja. Thereafter, Swamishri visited various prasadi places in the mandir complex on his way to the Mandir and Smruti Mandir.

Fully engrossed in doing darshan, Swamishri then performed arti with utmost devotion to Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Devotees once again had darshan of Swamishri while he returned from the mandir. The evening celebration was themed on Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s lifelong sacrifice for the service of society and the betterment of his devotees.

A collection of speeches, video presentations and dances, demonstrated how Swamishri has taken care of his devotees, stayed with them during hardships, served them until their last breath, and granted them the bliss of Akshardham. Pujya Keshavjivan Swami (Pujya Mahant Swami), Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami, Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami and Pujya Viveksagar Swami, and other senior sadhus shared their personal experiences and recollected incidents illustrating Swamishri’s love, care and compassion.

Everyone was overjoyed when Swamishri made his eagerly anticipated entrance on the stage at 5:30pm. As Swamishri entered, devotees and santos were overcome with emotion, many applauded and sang the ‘jay’ whilst others watched with hands folded, as tears of joy rolled down from their eyes.

Divinity emanated from Swamishri and reverberated everywhere. Sadguru santos welcomed Swamishri to the assembly with a variety of garlands. Everyone had the opportunity to honor their Guru and offer prayers by performing mantra pushpanjali and samuh arti. The evening reached its zenith as Swamishri passed through the middle of the assembly, giving close darshan to devotees on each side.

Devotees were overwhelmed and fulfilled by the rare opportunity of darshan from such close proximity. Swamishri then visited the Smruti Mandir to offer devotion to his Guru, Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj, on his birthday. The sadhus and thousands of devotees left with a great feeling of pride and elation as they had faith that whatever corner of the world they live, Swamishri is always with them.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj performs the murti pratishtha rituals of murtis to be installed in the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir in Bharkunda (taluka: Kathlal)
options.story:
Swamishri performed the murti pratishtha rituals of murtis to be installed in the newly built Swaminarayan Mandir in Bharkunda (taluka: Kathlal).

One who has imbibed character then his wealth brings him happiness.

To purify one's mind one needs to offer devotion to God, read scriptures and keep the company of good people.

There is no value in decorating oneself; value lies in having character.

Performs the customary arti in a dried coconut cup. Performs pratishtha of murtis for mandirs in Bharkunda village. Addresses the Kartiki Purnima assembly of more than 15,000 bhaktas. Performs murti pratishtha rituals. Performs the pratishtha arti. During the assembly. Performs pratishtha of murtis for mandir in Khanpur village. Bapa and bhaktas perform arti in the assembly hall to commemorate the 199th arti anniversary. Performs arti to celebrate its 199th anniversary. Blesses the assembly. Performs Shangar arti on Kartik Purnima day. Observes the catering arrangements of prasad. Blesses the bhaktas. Performs pratishtha of murtis for mandir in Bhatpura village. Gives a consecrated vegetable to a child. Morning puja on Dev Diwali: An Annakut of fresh vegetables with Bapa's seat arranged between a large scale. Prays to Akshar Purushottam Maharaj. During the Kartiki Purnima assembly. Performs the pratishtha arti of murtis for both mandirs.

options.headline: Previous day a yagna of 51 kunds
options.story:
The previous day a yagna of 51 kunds was held as part of the murti pratishtha rituals in Umreth. 350 participants participated in the yagna. The same day in the evening a grand procession of murtis was carried out by 7,000 devotees and well-wishers.

Swamishri performed murti-pratishtha rituals of Dham, Dhami and Mukta, Laxmi Narayan Dev and Guru Parampara. Thereafter an assembly was held in which 9,000 devotees were present. Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Swamishri departed from Umreth and reached Dakor at 1.15 p.m. In the evening Swamishri went for darshan of the holy places in Dakor, namely, Gomti pond, Danknath Mahadev (where Bhakta Bodana had brought the murti of Ranchhodrayji from Dwarika and placed it there) and Ranchhodrayji mandir where he was honored and welcomed by the trustees.

Swamishri blessed the evening satsang assembly in Dakor.

After dinner Swamishri met the mahants of different mandirs in Dakor.

Performs murti-pratishtha of Shri Dham, Dhami and Mukta. Gopalanand Swami had often stayed in Umreth. At the old Swaminarayan Mandir for darshan. Addresses the assembly. Visits the Amreshwar Mandir for darshan. Bapa and bhaktas perform the murti-pratishtha arti. Also visits the Santram Mandir. Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Umreth. Shri Laxminarayan Dev. Aksharbrahma Gunatitanand Swami, Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Gopalanand Swami. The sinhasan with the deities. The murti-pratishtha assembly. The assembly stage.
